checks.claim: A road's crushed stone base spreads the load of the cars and lets water drain.
checks.why: Engineering guides: angular crushed stone interlocks to spread traffic loads, and its open structure drains.

sources.title: What makes a good road (Wisconsin LTAP)

checks.claim: Water trapped in a road's base weakens it.
checks.why: Water in the base lowers its load-bearing strength and leads to cracking and potholes.

sources.title: Let It Drain: Protecting Roads from Moisture Damage (Pavement Interactive)

checks.claim: Asphalt binds the stone together and seals the road surface.
checks.why: The asphalt binder glues the aggregate together and provides a waterproof seal.

sources.title: Functions of Surface Treatments and Seal Coats (TxDOT)

checks.claim: Painted road lines contain glass beads that reflect headlights at night.
checks.why: Glass beads embedded in the paint retroreflect headlight light back to the driver.
